title: Reports
description: Ask for the data you need in natural language and download it as Excel or PDF

ask.label: What data do you need?
ask.placeholder: Describe the report, e.g. "name and address of clients with any activity this year, VIP first"

intro: Describe the data you want to see. The AI prepares the query and shows you what it understood and the result, which you can sort and download as Excel or PDF. Save the reports you use often.
intro_readonly: Choose a saved report from the list.
name_required: Enter a name for the report (150 characters max).
not_understood: I couldn't turn the request into a report. Try other words.
failed: A valid query could not be created for this request. Try other words or more detail.
run_error: This report could not be run.
not_allowed: This report uses data that is no longer allowed in reports.

chart.empty: Nothing to draw. Choose at least one value.
chart.no_numeric: This report has no numeric columns to draw a chart. Ask, for example, for "number of clients per country" or "activities per month this year".
chart.truncated: The chart shows the first {n} rows of {total}.

comment.title: AI commentary
comment.intro: The AI can read the result and point out what matters: trends, peaks, concentrations or odd values.
comment.generated: Generated on {date} with the data at that time
comment.working: The AI is analysing the data…
comment.failed: The report could not be commented on. Please try again.
